digest.en: Nepal eases post-demonetisation curbs on Indian currency, allowing ₹200 and ₹500 notes. Venezuela men sue aviation firms that flew them to a notorious Salvadorian jail. Guyanese authorities confirm the death of 72 people in the sinking of a coastal ferry.
digest.hi: अमेरिकी नेवी के दो युद्धपोत समंदर में डूबने के बाद तनाव बढ़ गया है, जिससे पाकिस्तान से भी कनेक्शन सामने आया है। इस घटना ने अमेरिकी नौसेना को मजबूती से खड़ा करने के लिए मजबूर किया है।

articles.title: Nepal eases post-demonetisation curbs on Indian currency; allows ₹200, ₹500 notes
articles.summary: Following the demonetisation, Nepal prohibited the entry and use of Indian currency notes of denominations above ₹100; while the ceiling of ₹25,000 on carrying Indian currency remained unchanged, travellers were effectively restricted to notes of ₹100 and below. Nepal eases post-demonetisation curbs on Indian currency; allows ₹200, ₹500 notes.

articles.title: Venezuela men sue aviation firms who flew them to notorious Salvadorian jail
articles.summary: Exclusive: CSI Aviation and GlobalX accused of violating civil rights as part of Trump immigration crackdownVenezuelan men sent last year to a notorious Salvadorian terrorism prison by the Trump administration are suing the US aviation companies that transported them there. Venezuela men sue aviation firms who flew them to notorious Salvadorian jail.

articles.title: Ryan Gosling joins Marvel Cinematic Universe as Ghost Rider, film set for release in 2028
articles.summary: The actor will make his Marvel Cinematic Universe debut as Ghost Rider in a standalone film directed by Shawn Levy, as Marvel Studios also unveiled new details about Black Panther 3 and Avengers at Comic-Con. Ryan Gosling joins Marvel Cinematic Universe as Ghost Rider, film set for release in 2028.

articles.title: Why every senior should strength train – and it's not just to prevent falls
articles.summary: Weakening muscles don't only increase the risk of falls in seniors. A new study suggests sarcopenia may also reduce the body's cancer-suppressing ability. Here’s why strength training is one of the best things your parents can do – along with exercise demonstrations by a 77-year-old. Why every senior should strength train – and it's not just to prevent falls.

articles.title: Venezuela notifies UN of withdrawal from ICC, alleging 'bias'
articles.summary: The government justified ​the move by alleging a “geographical bias” within the court, claiming it ⁠disproportionately targets nations in the Global South, specifically across Africa and Latin America, Felix Plasencia said in a post on X. Venezuela notifies UN of withdrawal from ICC, alleging 'bias'.

articles.title: Attacks On Chinese Projects Test China-Pakistan 'Iron Brotherhood' In Balochistan
articles.summary: China's investments in Pakistan's Balochistan are increasingly at risk as attacks by separatists are on the rise in the impoverished region. The worsening security situation has strained ties between the Iron Brothers, raising concerns over the future of Beijing's investments in Pakistan. Attacks On Chinese Projects Test China-Pakistan 'Iron Brotherhood' In Balochistan.

articles.title: Politicians vs generals: Ukraine’s long, hidden war within
articles.summary: The Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelensky, has dismissed the country’s commander-in-chief, Oleksandr Syrskyi, after a turbulent week in which he also removed his defense minister, Mykhailo Fedorov. The dismissal of the popular defense minister, who is credited by many as the brains behind Ukraine’s successful drone strategy, brought thousands onto the streets in protest. articles.title: The hidden workers behind Indonesia’s digital boom
articles.summary: Today, Indonesia stands as one of the most formidable digital economic powerhouses in Southeast Asia. Bank Indonesia recorded digital payment transaction volumes reaching 5.22 billion in May 2026, marking 28.14% year-on-year growth. Meanwhile, QRIS transactions. the country’s standardized QR payment system. surged by an astounding 95.10%. articles.title: Trump Says Iran 'Far More Serious' In Talks, Even As Attacks Intensify, Widen In Region
articles.summary: US President Donald ⁠Trump ⁠said Washington and Tehran were still conducting negotiations to end their conflict -- even as attacks intensified throughout the region, further threatening to widen the conflict into a full-blown Middle East war. Trump Says Iran 'Far More Serious' In Talks, Even As Attacks Intensify, Widen In Region.

articles.title: Iranian Sisters, Aged 20, Tried In High-Profile Case Tied To January Protests
articles.summary: Sixteen people are facing charges connected to protests in Isfahan in January, during which a colonel in Iran's Revolutionary Guard was killed. Rights defenders are raising concerns about the legitimacy of the case, including the charges against 20-year-old sisters Taraneh and Romina Rahimi. Iranian Sisters, Aged 20, Tried In High-Profile Case Tied To January Protests.

articles.title: Russia's 'Axis Of Upheaval' Is Built To Last Beyond Ukraine, Analyst Kendall-Taylor Says
articles.summary: Russia's deepening partnerships with China, Iran, and North Korea represent one of the most significant geopolitical realignments driven by the war in Ukraine. Yet according to Andrea Kendall-Taylor, viewing this grouping through the lens of a traditional military alliance misses the bigger picture. Russia's 'Axis Of Upheaval' Is Built To Last Beyond Ukraine, Analyst Kendall-Taylor Says.

articles.title: Guyanese authorities confirm death of 72 people in sinking of coastal ferry
articles.summary: Guyanese authorities confirm 72 deaths after a state ferry capsized off the coast, leaving 179 people aboard. Of the estimated 179 people aboard, 76 were rescued as efforts continue to salvage the ship and recover all bodiesThe confirmed death toll from the recent capsizing of a state ferry off Guyana’s coast has risen to 72, with more bodies recovered as a multinational team struggle to salvage the partially submerged vessel. Of the estimated 179 people aboard, 76 people were rescued.

articles.title: Iran-Iraq-Pakistan ‘axis of sympathy’ signals a reshaping Southwest Asia
articles.summary: Earlier this month, the Supreme Leader of Iran, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, was buried in his hometown of Mashhad after a four-day ceremony. Many international delegations were present, but each country will have chosen their representatives with the utmost care. Sending high-ranking officials would go beyond mere diplomatic courtesy, and possibly signal an alliance. articles.title: ‘Women do not stop giving birth in an emergency’ – one month after Venezuela quakes
articles.summary: One month after twin earthquakes rocked Venezuela, thousands of women and girls continue to face difficulty in accessing essential healthcare and protection services, a senior official with the UN reproductive and sexual health agency UNFPA said on Friday. ‘Women do not stop giving birth in an emergency’ – one month after Venezuela quakes.

articles.title: After an Ebola centre was attacked, peacekeepers moved in next door
articles.summary: A new mobile UN peacekeeping base in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has allowed local authorities to continue responding to the fast-moving Ebola outbreak there after violence disrupted the work of medics at a treatment centre set up to contain the spread. After an Ebola centre was attacked, peacekeepers moved in next door.

articles.title: In El Obeid, Sudanese women face drones by day, rape by night, to reach water
articles.summary: In El Obeid, women and girls now face an impossible choice over something as basic as a bucket of water: risk a drone strike by collecting it in daylight, or risk rape by waiting until dark. In El Obeid, Sudanese women face drones by day, rape by night, to reach water.

articles.title: Masked men invading and taking Amazon communities ‘hostage’ in organised crime surge, say local
articles.summary: Delegation sent to Brasília after gunmen from organised crime group enter homes in western Amazon ForestIndigenous leaders on the Brazil-Peru border say their communities are being “taken hostage” by organised crime groups who are running rampant across the region, destroying Amazon Forest, building roads and trafficking drugs. Earlier this month, masked men armed with semi-automatic weapons entere Gangs taking villages on Brazil-Peru border ‘hostage’, say Indigenous leaders.

articles.title: Ukraine Hits More Wildberries Warehouses Near St. Petersburg, Occupied Crimea
articles.summary: Ukrainian drones struck Wildberries logistics hubs near St. Petersburg and in occupied Crimea, causing fires and disruptions. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine also hit a key military facility in Russia’s Kirov region that supplies components for aircraft and missile systems. Ukraine Hits More Wildberries Warehouses Near St. Petersburg, Occupied Crimea.

articles.title: Wildberries, 'Russia's Amazon,' Hit Again In New Wave Of Ukrainian Strikes
articles.summary: Ukraine struck targets in several parts of Russia early on July 24, including another warehouse of Russian e-commerce retailer Wildberries, as Kyiv continues to expand its retaliatory long-range strike campaign in an effort to force Moscow into negotiations. Wildberries, 'Russia's Amazon,' Hit Again In New Wave Of Ukrainian Strikes.

articles.title: Iranians find community in art, culture and memes as missiles fly
articles.summary: Coverage of the conflict between Iran, Israel and the United States has largely focused on battlefield developments, political statements and international diplomacy. However, another story has been unfolding on the streets of Iran. Despite fears of further military escalation dominating daily life, residents continue to take up space, both in person and online. articles.title: Saudi Ally Pakistan Issues Warning After Houthi Attacks On Tankers In Red Sea
articles.summary: Islamabad has condemned attacks by Iran-backed Houthi rebels on Saudi-flagged vessels in the Red Sea. It also warned that any aggressive actions toward Pakistan-flagged vessels or the country's maritime interests would be regarded as a “grave threat” that may result in “lawful use of force.” Saudi Ally Pakistan Issues Warning After Houthi Attacks On Tankers In Read Sea. Saudi Ally Pakistan Issues Warning After Houthi Attacks On Tankers In Red Sea.

articles.title: On The Front Line Of Ukraine's Drone War Over Kramatorsk
articles.summary: Ukrainian drone-interceptor crews are working around the clock to stop Russian reconnaissance and attack drones approaching the frontline city of Kramatorsk. RFE/RL spent a night with one team defending the skies as aerial attacks intensify. On The Front Line Of Ukraine's Drone War Over Kramatorsk.

articles.title: Iran urged to stop protest-related executions
articles.summary: Independent UN human rights investigators on Thursday called for Iran to immediately halt the execution of 10 men who took part in a protest in the central city of Isfahan earlier this year, warning that some of their relatives have already been called for final visits. Iran urged to stop protest-related executions.

articles.title: Gaza’s food gains could unravel without sustained aid, UN warns
articles.summary: Food security and child nutrition have improved across the Gaza Strip largely due to a scale-up in humanitarian assistance and commercial traffic, but progress remains fragile and could quickly reverse without sustained access, funding and recovery support. Gaza’s food gains could unravel without sustained aid, UN warns.

articles.title: Stranded seafarers remain trapped as Hormuz shipping stalls
articles.summary: As the Iran-US war continues, the key question remains unanswered about how shipping through the Strait of Hormuz will be managed in future – although the UN has reiterated that charging tolls for safe passage runs contrary to international law. Stranded seafarers remain trapped as Hormuz shipping stalls.

'जीविका दीदियों को नहीं हटाया तो धरने पर बैठूंगा', प्रशांत किशोर ने सरकार को दी चुनौती।

articles.summary: भारत के लिए राहत की बात यह है कि रूस से आने वाला अधिकांश कच्चा तेल हूतियों के निशाने पर नहीं आने वाला, लेकिन कई जोखिम हैं जो वैश्विक तेल सप्लाई को प्रभावित कर सकते हैं। Russian Oil India News: अमेरिका-ईरान तनाव के बीच ईरान समर्थित हूती विद्रोहियों ने फिर लाल सागर में हमले तेज कर दिए हैं. इससे वैश्विक तेल सप्लाई को लेकर चिंता बढ़ गई है.

articles.title: कारगिल से राजनाथ का पाकिस्तान को दो टूक: बोले-बात होगी तो सिर्फ POK पर, हर दुस्साहस का मिलेगा करारा
articles.summary: रक्षा मंत्री राजनाथ सिंह ने कहा कि भारत और पाकिस्तान के बीच बातचीत होगी, लेकिन यह सिर्फ पूर्वी पाकिस्तान (पाकिस्तान-occupied कश्मीर) पर होगी। उन्होंने कहा कि हर दुस्साहस का जवाब देने के लिए तैयार रहेंगे। कारगिल विजय दिवस की 27वीं वर्षगांठ। कारगिल से राजनाथ का पाकिस्तान को दो टूक: बोले-बात होगी तो सिर्फ POK पर, हर दुस्साहस का मिलेगा करारा।

articles.title: रूस और यूक्रेन ने एक-दूसरे पर फिर किए हमले, 15 की गई जान
articles.summary: रूस और यूक्रेन के बीच युद्ध एक बार फिर तेज हो गया है, शनिवार को दोनों देशों ने एक-दूसरे पर बड़े हमले किए, जिसमें 15 लोगों की जान चली गई। Russia Ukraine Conflict: रूस और यूक्रेन के बीच जारी युद्ध एक बार फिर तेज हो गया है। रूस के कब्जे वाले जापोरिज्जिया क्षेत्र में छुट्टियां मना रहे लोगों के कैंपों पर हुए यूक्रेनी हमले में 12 लोगों की मौत हो गई।
